name: Koppányszántó (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of blue and yellow at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Koppányszántó: a blue shield with a white plough, with a helm, a figure crest and blue and yellow mantling, above a scroll.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Koppányszántó arms with helm, crest, mantling and scroll
